title: Be strong
textBlocks:
Be strong. Be brave
Hello BraveHearts
In your lesson today you are going to learn a LONG LONG BIG BIG WORD
C O U R A G E O U S
( say C - RA - JUHS)

THE LORD TOLD JOSHUA NOT TO BE AFRAID
HE TOLD JOSHUA TO BE BOLD (strong) and COURAGEOUS
Joshua’s job was to lead all the people into the promised land and to fight battles. He had to be STRONG & COURAGEOUS.

CRAFT TIME
Let us make strong lion masks 
to remind us what God told Joshua
SEND US PHOTOS OF YOUR CREATION
